calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
f AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(v) AS fact_net
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
c AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net, COUNT(DISTINCT r.business_date) AS days
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(f.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, COALESCE(f.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) AS fy, f.fact_net, c.ctl_net, c.days,
       ROUND(f.fact_net - c.ctl_net, 2) AS gap
FROM f FULL JOIN c ON f.store_id=c.store_id AND f.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'dup_sales_keys' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, NULL AS x FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), NULL FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_ids', COUNT(*), NULL FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closures_overlapping', COUNT(*), string_agg(store_id || ':' || closure_start_date || '..' || closure_end_date, '; ') FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_nonstandard', COUNT(*), string_agg(store_id || ' ' || store_name || ' open=' || COALESCE(CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR),'-') || ' close=' || COALESCE(CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR),'-'), '; ') FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND (open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'physical_stores_current', COUNT(*), NULL FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) prods, COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) nets
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT c, mn=mx AS same_date, loads, prods, nets, COUNT(*) n, MIN(mn) first_d, MAX(mn) last_d FROM d GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
